q: Does hydro power make Quebec aluminium cheaper under CBAM?
title: Quebec hydro aluminium and CBAM
short: Not directly. For aluminium only direct emissions are charged: anode carbon and PFCs. Quebec smelters' hydro power lowers their product footprint, not the CBAM figure. A Quebec carbon market price can be deducted only to the extent it is effectively paid.
audience: EU buyers of Canadian primary aluminium and smelters in Quebec

ul: CO2 from anode consumption in the pots.
Fuel used in the cast house and anode baking on site.

p: Buyers' cradle to gate footprints include electricity, and hydro power makes Quebec metal one of the lowest-carbon sources on that basis. That helps with buyer targets even though the CBAM figure stays the same.
Quebec runs a cap-and-trade system in which smelters receive free allowances. Only the price effectively paid beyond that allocation can be deducted.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.
